evidence.description: settings_load_validate_save @ 0x00262778 loads 0x190-byte settings block from raw SD @ 0x28000000, validates integrity, writes defaults if invalid. Called during boot_init.
settings_save_block @ 0x002661e0 saves 0x190-byte settings block to raw SD @ 0x28000000. Called from ui_main_loop and other UI paths when settings change.

settings_save_calibration_slots @ 0x00265ea8 writes 100 calibration slots (16 bytes each) to raw SD at 0x28800000 + i*0x4D000. Range: 0x28800000 - 0x28B2B000. Hypothesis: touch calibration points and alignment data.

Empirical test: Clean SD image (gaps zeroed) boots successfully but loses touch calibration and language settings. White blocks appear instead of text (font/language config missing). Settings restored after manual calibration and language selection.

Binary diff after boot: Settings written to gaps in range 0x000D3000 - 0x00275400 containing strings 'touch', 'calib', 'lang', 'align'. This corresponds to raw SD sectors starting at 0x28000000 when shifted by sector alignment.

provenance: Ghidra analysis (2026-01-14) + empirical boot test with clean SD image
summary: Device settings (language, touch calibration) are stored in RAW SD regions starting at 0x28000000. Main settings block (0x190 bytes) contains UI config and language. Calibration data stored in 100 slots of 16 bytes each at 0x28800000 + i*0x4D000. Settings loaded/validated at boot, saved on UI changes.
title: Settings Persistence Layer: RAW SD Storage @ 0x28000000
